name: dsh-session-manager
description: Session radar for DSH: right-edge quick launch bar, live session telemetry with stall and approval-wait alerts, token throughput, status filters and sort orders, workspace history and pins, a per-round conversation tree that shows the user's instruction and the agent's reply on every round, forks a new branch from any round, and opens the whole tree in the right Sidebar from a configurable entry (floating, draggable, beside the composer, both or none), plus statistics over an arbitrary custom window with range-scoped token spend, a workspaces/sessions scope picker, and wall-clock duration instead of a sum of sessions.

scripts.test:quicknav: node scripts/build-client.mjs && node scripts/check-card-sidebar.mjs && node scripts/check-quicknav-ui.mjs
